verdict.label: LIKELY_WRONGFUL
verdict.summary: Your claim of ₹1,20,000 was wrongly rejected under the pre-existing disease clause. Your continuous coverage of 49 months exceeds the 36-month waiting period specified in your policy and regulatory rules.

facts.rejection_reason_text: We regret to inform you that your claim is repudiated under Clause 4.1 (Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period) as the patient has history of Hypertension which is a pre-existing condition.
facts.cited_clause_text: Pre-existing Diseases (Code- Excl01): Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.

rejection_reason_text.quote: We regret to inform you that your claim is repudiated under Clause 4.1 (Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period) as the patient has history of Hypertension which is a pre-existing condition.

rules.name: PED waiting period
rules.explanation: Continuous coverage of 49 months exceeds the 36-month waiting period specified in Clause 4.1 and the IRDAI 2024 Master Circular. The pre-existing disease waiting period was fully completed before admission.
rules.law_ref: IRDAI Master Circular on Operations and Allied Matters of Insurers - Health Insurance 2024, Clause 4.1 & Insurance Ombudsman Rules 2017
